reports.desc: On Sept. 16, 2026 I purchased quilted bags from Easylifexo and paid for them with a Visa credit card. The only communication I received at that time was they got paid. In two weeks I wrote Easylifexo where was my product and in their reply was a tracking link. I have since been checking the tracking and it looks like it was in Marion, Illinois for several days and then the link said it was delivered Oct. 18, 2026 but it was not. I have contacted Easylifexo and their response was to check my delivery notification which I never got and to check with my family and neighbors to see if it was delivered to another home. My address is very clear on my receipt and we get correct deliveries all the time. I have asked for proof of delivery and will be asking my credit card company for a refund.

I keep getting emails from not just this email address but multiple about a loan that I have taken out and they're all with the same exact amount. I've not clicked on any of them, but I haven't had any loans taken out so I did some research and see that this website is trying to scam a bunch of people.

They said the automatic payment system was down temporarily and to pay through him and he would send me a confirmation number, which he never did. The amount he quoted as owed was the wrong amount as quoted  by my son. I tried to pay what my son owed on his phone bill.
I looked into applying for a delivery job, but have no communication in over 2 weeks.  They took my id and insurance information, but no follow up.
I ordered from DAMOUR INC. and never received my order and was charged $41.96. I have reached out to then but never sent me the product or reimbursed me.
I ordered from them and received nothing and couldn’t reach them by email.

I ordered flowers for my daughter and thought i was ordering from a local florist.  The order was placed and psid for my debit card and minutes later canceled saying they did not deliver to her lstham address.

Order placed may 2026 never received merchandise sent several emails they responded saying they would refund my account but did not,  I contacted them again they assured me my refund was being processed still nothing now their customer service and website has been removed
I ordered some highway half-waisted package of eight pants online which I never received ordered on October 4th and today is the 16th of 2026 thank you

Just as all others have reported about kittysupps.com i got a text message stating my order was on its way. I NEVER ORDERED ANYTHING FROM KITTY SUPPS THIS TIME. THE CONTACTS FROM THIS SCAM SITE ARE OF NO USE. THE GOVERNMENT NEEDS TO SHUT THIS WEBSITE DOWN!

Mail sent to our office indicating our Domain name was expiring and a 5 year renewal was due and needed. Person paying did not know or realize they did not hold our domain. Attempts to immediately cancel the charge were made, but person's via the "support" email were rude and ignored requests for cancelation and refund.
The products sold online do not match the products received and no refunds will be issued
